prompt: Create a vertical Japanese summer fashion magazine poster featuring a beautiful young Japanese woman walking through shallow, crystal-clear turquoise seawater on a bright sunny day. She is centered full-body, photographed from a slightly low front angle, looking off to the viewer’s right with a calm elegant expression, wind-blown short brown bob hair, natural makeup, pearl earrings, and luminous sunlit skin. Outfit: a pale blue ribbed tank top, high-waisted white tailored shorts with a small belt, and a sheer loose white long-sleeve cover-up shirt slipping open and flowing in the sea breeze. The water reaches her lower calves with sparkling splashes around one stepping foot, visible rippling sand patterns under the water, a flat ocean horizon, soft white clouds, and an intense clear blue sky. Use a clean airy editorial photography style, high-key lighting, pastel cyan and white color palette, glossy Japanese lifestyle magazine aesthetic, realistic fashion-photo detail, gentle lens flare, crisp fabric texture, and refreshing summer atmosphere. Add large translucent Japanese typography integrated into the sky and sea: oversized white characters near the top reading 「夏透明」 with pale blue vertical text on the right reading 「の涼風」 and oversized pale blue characters near the lower left reading 「海」. Add one small vertical Japanese tagline at upper left-center: 「夏が来る きらめく海辺で、私らしく。」 Add small English footer text: bottom left “SUMMER COLLECTION” and “2024”; bottom right “LIGHT / CLEAR / BREEZE”. Keep the composition minimalist and elegant, with text partially blending into the bright sky and water, no extra people, no buildings, no logos, no watermark. Customize the mood with refreshing midsummer seaside, outfit color with pale blue, and the main large Japanese title with 夏透明の涼風海.

promptZh: 创作一张竖版日系夏季时尚杂志海报，主角为 一位美丽的年轻日本女性，她正漫步在明媚晴天里浅浅的、晶莹剔透的绿松石色海水中。她位于画面中心，全身像，采用略微仰视的正面视角拍摄，神情平静优雅，看向观者的右侧，留着被海风吹拂的棕色短波波头，妆容自然，佩戴珍珠耳环，皮肤在阳光下熠熠生辉。服装：浅蓝色罗纹背心，高腰白色剪裁短裤配细腰带，外搭一件半透明的宽松白色长袖罩衫，罩衫随海风轻轻飘动。海水没过她的小腿，迈步的脚边激起闪烁的水花，水下可见波纹状的沙地，远处是平坦的海平线、柔软的白云和湛蓝的天空。采用干净通透的编辑摄影风格，高调照明，青色与白色的柔和色调，呈现光泽感的日系生活杂志美学，具备写实的时尚摄影细节、柔和的镜头光晕、清晰的织物纹理和清爽的夏日氛围。在天空和海面融入大型半透明日文排版：顶部附近为超大白色文字「夏透明」，右侧为淡蓝色竖排文字「の涼風」，左下方为超大淡蓝色文字「海」。在左上方中心位置添加一行小型竖排日文标语：「夏が来る きらめく海辺で、私らしく。」在底部添加小型英文页脚：左下角为“SUMMER COLLECTION”和“2024”；右下角为“LIGHT / CLEAR / BREEZE”。构图保持极简与优雅，文字部分融入明亮的天空与海水中，画面中无其他人物、无建筑物、无 Logo、无水印。可通过 清爽仲夏海滨 自定义氛围，通过 浅蓝色 自定义背心颜色，并通过 夏透明の涼風海 自定义主标题文字。
